description: Check a page's HTML/CSS/copy/interaction for the patterns that make AI-generated work read as generic: default fonts, soft tech gradients, pill+arrow buttons, eyebrow labels, a composition with no real width/background variation across sections, uniform card grids, copy tells (AI vocabulary, negative-parallel framing, hedge words, heavy em-dash use), and experience gaps (a diagnosis with no next step, dead-end links). Every finding includes a concrete fix. Call this before presenting UI to a human.

html.description: Raw HTML/CSS to check directly, if not fetching a URL
